decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Drawings 001, 002, 005, and 008, Unnumbered Proposed Rear Elevation Render, and Unnumbered Existing Condition received: 03/04/2018. Drawing ref: FLA received: 11/04/2018. Drawings 003, 004, 006, 007, and Flood Risk Assessment received: 14/06/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The development hereby permitted shall only be carried out in accordance with the approved Flood Risk Assessment and the extension shall  not be occupied until all the measures in the Flood Risk Assessment are implemented
description: Erection of a single storey rear and infill extension with wrap around to the existing house.
